title: Trithemius Corpus: machine-assisted English translations of a 47-work Latin corpus by Johannes Trithemius (1462-1516)
description: A machine-assisted English translation of a 47-work Latin corpus by Johannes Trithemius (Benedictine abbot of Sponheim, 1462-1516), produced via OCR, LLM translation, independent grading, targeted remediation, and keep-better revision. Current public release view: 4,400 published chunks across 47 translatable printed editions (29 distinct texts), 4,353 graded chunks, mean faithful 4.63/5, 0.0% confirmed hallucination, 100.0% of graded chunks at faithful >= 4 and not hallucinated, and tier distribution S=47 / A=0 / B=0 / C=0 / F=0. Covers his monastic-reform, devotional, Marian/hagiographic, bibliographic, historical, and cryptographic writings, including 23 of its 29 distinct texts (39 of 47 editions) with no located prior published English translation. Each work includes stitched English, OCR-cleaned Latin, source provenance, a researched headnote, per-chunk grades, and a side-by-side Latin / English viewer. See README.md, METHODOLOGY.md, and docs/PRIOR_TRANSLATIONS.md.
notes: Latin source texts are public domain, with institutional scans cited per work in manifest.json. Machine translations and generated corpus artifacts are released as CC0-1.0. Methodology, documentation, code, and corpus arrangement are licensed CC BY 4.0; see LICENSE.
